title: Bubbalous Bodacious BBQ
summary: Menu, party packs, catering, and ordering handoff for an Orlando BBQ restaurant.
description: A custom website for an Orlando BBQ restaurant, rebuilt around what hungry customers look for first: the menu, party packs, catering, and a fast way to order. The menu is organized into 9 categories, there are 4 party packs and 10 catering menus, and ordering hands off to the restaurant's delivery and pickup partners. Reviews and a photo gallery show the food, and the whole site is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
keyFeatures: Full Menu: 9 categories of dishes with descriptions, organized so customers can find what they want quickly.
Party Packs and Catering: 4 party packs plus 10 catering menus for events, with a service area covering 8 counties.
Order Online Handoff: Ordering sends customers to the restaurant's delivery and pickup partners, so there is no separate cart to maintain.
Reviews and Photo Gallery: 19 customer reviews and a 22-photo gallery that build trust before anyone walks in.
Three Languages: Every page is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese, with its own SEO metadata.
Self-Hosted Fonts: Archivo Expanded and Barlow load from the site's own domain for faster, more private page loads.
technologyStack: Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
Styling: CSS Modules with CSS custom properties
Data: JSON files for the menu, party packs, catering and reviews
Internationalization: English, Spanish and Portuguese routes with a language switcher
Fonts: Archivo Expanded and Barlow, self-hosted
Images: Next.js Image optimization
Analytics: Google Tag Manager
SEO: Next.js Metadata API with per-page titles and descriptions

title: Kingdom Movement
summary: Programs, class schedule, nutrition menu, coaches, and memberships for a CrossFit gym.
description: A custom website for an Orlando CrossFit gym that answers a new member's questions in order: what do you offer, when are classes, who will coach me, and what does it cost. It covers programs, a weekly class schedule, a 31-item nutrition menu, 5 coach profiles, 7 membership options, and member reviews, all in English, Spanish and Portuguese, with a bold look that matches the gym's brand.
keyFeatures: Programs Page: Explains what the gym offers so a first-time visitor knows where they fit.
Weekly Class Schedule: Day-by-day navigation with times, and clear messaging on closed days.
Nutrition Menu: 31 items across 4 categories, with descriptions, images and add-ons.
Coach Profiles: 5 coaches with photos and bios in a carousel with manual controls.
Membership Tiers: 7 options, from drop-in and a free class to full memberships, with benefits and sign-up links.
Member Reviews: 10 reviews that show the community before someone joins.
technologyStack: Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
Styling: CSS Modules with CSS variables
State: React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useRef)
Internationalization: English, Spanish and Portuguese routes with a language switcher
Data: JSON files for coaches, nutrition, schedule, memberships and reviews
Fonts: Self-hosted variable fonts with next/font/local
Images: Next.js Image optimization
Code Quality: ESLint with the Next.js configuration

title: Moonstar Esthetics
summary: Services, reviews, a blog, and booking for a skincare clinic, in three languages.
description: The live website for an Orlando esthetician, designed to feel calm and premium while making booking easy. It lists 4 categories of facial, laser, body and waxing services, shows client reviews, and includes a blog with 6 posts. The whole site is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Clients can book a specific service through the clinic's scheduling tool or message the esthetician on WhatsApp or by text. It ships with a dark default theme and a light theme.
keyFeatures: Service Catalog: 4 categories of treatments with pricing and duration, plus a category filter, search and sorting.
Booking Deep Links: Each service opens the scheduling tool with that service already selected.
Message Button: Clients can reach the esthetician on WhatsApp or by text with a prefilled greeting.
Three Languages: Every page and all 6 blog posts are available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
Client Reviews: A dedicated page of client reviews with star ratings.
Dark and Light Themes: Dark by default, with a toggle that remembers the visitor's choice.
technologyStack: Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
Styling: CSS Modules with theme variables
Content: Markdown blog posts per language, JSON for services and reviews
Internationalization: English, Spanish and Portuguese routes
Fonts: Montserrat and Newsreader via next/font/google
Booking: Setmore deep links
Icons: Font Awesome

title: Reelix
summary: Movie and TV discovery app on live TMDB data, with search and filtering.
description: Dive into the ultimate entertainment universe with Reelix! This cinematic discovery platform transforms how you explore movies and TV shows, featuring real-time data from the world's largest entertainment database. Navigate effortlessly through trending films, top-rated series, and personalized recommendations with lightning-fast performance. The sleek dark interface creates the perfect movie theater ambiance, while smart technology automatically adapts to your region and language preferences. Whether you're a casual viewer or film enthusiast, Reelix delivers an immersive entertainment experience that brings the magic of cinema to your fingertips.
keyFeatures: Top IMDB Ratings: Dedicated page showcasing the highest-rated movies from TMDB, with detailed metadata and certification information.
Performance Optimized: Leverages Next.js Image component for optimized image loading, font optimization, and efficient code splitting.
SEO Optimized: Built with Next.js for optimal search engine optimization, including proper metadata, semantic HTML, and server-side rendering.
Responsive Design: Fully responsive layout optimized for desktops, tablets, smartphones, and smart TVs, ensuring a consistent experience across all devices.
Advanced Filtering System: Users can filter movies and TV shows by genre, year, and country with real-time URL parameter updates for shareable filtered views.
Comprehensive Search: Powerful search functionality that queries both movies and TV shows simultaneously, intelligently selecting the best match based on vote counts.
Detailed Media Pages: Each movie or TV show features a comprehensive detail page with poster, backdrop banner, trailer links, cast, crew, genres, ratings, and runtime information.
technologyStack: Frameworks/Libraries: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
Styling: CSS Modules for scoped, maintainable component styling
Font Optimization: Next.js Font Optimization (Bebas Neue, Montserrat)
Runtime: Node.js
Framework: Next.js (Server-Side Rendering, API Routes)
API Integration: The Movie Database (TMDB) API for real-time media data
Image Optimization: Next.js Image component for optimized image loading
Environment Variables: Next.js environment variable management
Deployment: Optimized for Vercel, Netlify, or similar Next.js-compatible platforms

title: Redline Collision Center
summary: Portfolio concept: one fast, organized site for a fictional three-shop collision repair group.
description: A portfolio concept for a fictional collision repair group with three shops. It is built for a driver on a phone right after an accident, who needs to know three things fast: is this shop good, is it close, and how do I reach them. Each shop has its own page with hours, an open-now status, and an on-site map, and every service links back to all three locations. The business, shops, addresses and reviews are all made up, and the site is hidden from search engines.
keyFeatures: Three Locations, One Source of Truth: Every shop name, address, phone number and set of hours lives in one typed content file, so the site can never disagree with itself.
Open-Now Status: Each shop shows whether it is open right now, computed in Eastern Time after the page loads to avoid hydration mismatches.
Call-First Mobile Layout: A sticky action bar and call panel keep Get Directions and one-tap calling within reach on a phone.
Estimate Request Form: A plain, validated form with clear errors and a normal success state. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the legal pages say so.
Training and Standards Page: Shows general technician training as text badges, with no claims of carmaker certification.
Structured Data and Hidden by Design: Location, service, FAQ and breadcrumb schema are built per page, while robots rules and headers keep the fictional business out of search results.
technologyStack: Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19, React Compiler
Language: TypeScript in strict mode
Styling: Plain CSS with global design tokens and one CSS Module per component
Content: Typed content files for locations, services, FAQs and reviews
Fonts: Archivo Expanded and Inter, self-hosted with next/font/local
Icons: Lucide
SEO: Metadata builder and JSON-LD schema builders, noindex headers
